Request an outing

Send an outing request straight to the shelter's email. They'll reply to you by email or phone to confirm details and next steps.

Your request goes to the shelter you picked (right away if it runs a program, or in our monthly note if it doesn't), with a copy kept by ShelterDayOut so we can help if something goes wrong. See our privacy policy.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
